sections.heading: 1. Introduction
body: Welcome to Projet-Genesis, an application dedicated to tabletop role-playing game (RPG) enthusiasts. This application lets you create scenarios and characters, either manually or with semi-automated assistance. It also offers additional features, such as weapon creation. These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your use of the application. By using this application, you agree to these Terms.

sections.heading: 2. Acceptance of the Terms
body: By accessing or using Projet-Genesis, you agree to be bound by these Terms. If you do not agree to these Terms, you must not use the application. We encourage you to read these Terms carefully before using our service.

sections.heading: 3. Access to and use of the application
body: The application is intended for anyone aged 13 or older. If you are under 13, you must obtain permission from a parent or guardian to use this application. You are responsible for all activity that occurs under your account and must ensure that all information you provide during registration is accurate and complete.

sections.heading: 4. User accounts
body: To access the application, you must create a user account. You agree to provide accurate information and to keep it up to date if it changes. You are responsible for the security of your account and for any actions taken through it.
If you notice suspicious activity on your account, you must notify us immediately. We reserve the right to suspend or delete accounts without notice in the event of a breach of these Terms.

sections.heading: 5. Intellectual property
body: All content available on the application, including text, images, graphics, logos, user interfaces, and source code, is protected by copyright and other intellectual property laws. The application and its content are the exclusive property of the development team.

You may use the application and its content only for your personal, non-commercial use of the application. Any reproduction, distribution, modification, or other use of the content without prior authorization is strictly prohibited.

sections.heading: 6. Changes to the Terms
body: We reserve the right to modify these Terms at any time. If we make significant changes, we will notify you through the application or by any other appropriate means. Your continued use of the application after the changes take effect constitutes your acceptance of those changes. We recommend reviewing these Terms regularly to stay informed of any updates.

sections.heading: 1. Introduction
body: This Privacy Policy explains how Projet-Genesis (hereafter "the application") collects, uses, and protects the personal information of its users. By using our application, you agree to the practices described in this policy.

sections.heading: 2. Information We Collect
body: The application exclusively uses OAuth authentication to let users sign in. OAuth is a standardized protocol that enables secure authorization in a simplified setup. By using OAuth, the application does not store your credentials directly (such as passwords) but instead receives an access token that verifies your identity with the OAuth service provider (such as Google, Facebook, etc.).
During OAuth authentication, we collect and use only the information necessary to create and manage your user account on our application. This includes:
list1: Profile picture (optional, depending on the OAuth provider)
User ID provided by the OAuth service
body2: To operate the application, the following technical data and content are also stored in our database:
list2: OAuth access and refresh tokens received from the provider, attached to your account
Login sessions: session identifier and expiration date. Your IP address and browser (user agent) are not stored in these sessions
The content you create: scenarios, characters, weapons, and suggestions

sections.heading: 3. Data Security
body: We take the security of your data very seriously and implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.
Communications between your browser and the application are encrypted using the HTTPS (TLS) protocol.

OAuth access and refresh tokens received from the provider are stored in the application's database to maintain your login session. They are protected by the hosting provider's and database provider's access controls, but they are not subject to additional encryption at the application level.

To limit abusive requests, your connection's IP address is used transiently by the authentication system; it is kept in memory only for a short window of time and is not stored in the database or in your sessions.

sections.heading: 4. Data retention and deletion
body: Your data is retained for as long as your account exists. You may request deletion of your account. This deletion erases your account, your sessions, your scenarios, your weapons, and your characters.
Suggestions you have written are retained anonymously: the reference to their author is removed, and they are kept as moderation data.

sections.heading: 5. Changes to this Privacy Policy
body: We reserve the right to modify this Privacy Policy at any time. In the event of a substantial change, we will notify you through the application or by another appropriate means. We encourage you to review this policy regularly to stay informed of any updates.
